reviews.text: We recently took our dog to What The Pup for his very first grooming session, and I honestly couldn't be more impressed. The team went above and beyond, the results speak for themselves, he came home looking absolutely brilliant. But what stood out even more than the finish was how much care they clearly put into making him feel comfortable. He came back relaxed and happy, with zero anxiety, which for a first-time groom is no small thing. You can tell this isn't just a job for them, they genuinely look after the dogs in their care. We'll absolutely be back. Highly recommend!
A wonderful team who really care and are passionate about what they do!
Brought my daughter puppy in for his first groom today we couldn't be happier friendly staff professionals at what they do I  highly recommend what the pup

My doggy had a bad experience at a groomers. The wonderful angels at What the Pup understood his nervousness, invited him to play and get to know them before booking a groom for him at the quietest time to ease his stress. He now looks forward to seeing them and leaves happy, with a bounce in his step and looking even more gorgeous
So good! Full groom for my cat and they did a great job getting rid of matts and sprucing him up. Lovely staff.
Great service lovely staff

Thank you Maria, for caring for my baby and grooming him so carefully.
I was quite worried at first, but when I picked him up, he was obviously in good mood. See you next time.

If I could award more than 5 stars I would! It would be a massive understatement to say that our dog doesn’t like going to a groomer. I was starting to despair that we were running out of groomers to try. Then What The Pup came along and everything changed. They set themselves up for success from the very first appointment. Booked us in for the first slot on a quiet morning and made sure that there was a second person to help keep her calm while she was being groomed. I won’t lie, she is still nervous, and so quite a tricky customer, but with every appointment that is improving. A sure sign that she’s feeling safe in their hands. … and she looks wonderful afterwards too! A big thanks to What The Pup! Grace.   PS I hardly ever post reviews for anything - because it’s not my thing - but these guys deserve all the support they can get.

My cat Mushy got a full groom at What the Pup two days ago. The two staff did an incredible job. Mushy had several mats in her undercoat. The staff managed to brush and comb the mats out without shaving her at all. She still smells great from the bath. My cat was very well treated and wasn’t stressed by the experience. She has been very happy since the groom, now that she doesn’t have mats in her coat, is fresh and clean and well trimmed. We will definitely be back again.

What an amazing experience for jeffy our pup and ourselves, he loved his very first groom... A lovely experience we were met by the groomer and she went through everything so we felt very confident leaving him in good hands. Would highly recommend....”

We got our 2 Yorkshire terriers groomed there on Tuesday, we were so happy with the results very professional did exactly what we asked. Would highly recommend them 5stars. Definitely will return. Breda & mike. + Bablo &piccollo.

We cannot say enough about the service and customer experience WTP provide. We have a pup who’s had previous bad experiences, and so was previously quite anxious going to groomers. Maria and co really care, have gone out of their way to make her feel safe by booking her in at quieter times, slowly introducing the hair dryer amongst many other things. Our girl now loves going to WTP and each time we go, they see an improvement which is a testament to the service they provide. We’re grateful to be clients and highly recommend to others.

We've been looking for ages for a good groomer in Dublin that would be able to look after cats. WTP's dedicated cat grooming times are an incredible service. Staff was attentive, friendly and professional and I can't believe what an amazing job they did with our cat Nugget! Thanks so much, What the Pup!

Brought our 1 year old Maltichon here as our regular groomers were fully booked. After 15 minutes they called to say they had terminated his grooming as our dog didn't like it & basically he squirmed too much & the girl couldn't get him under control. They had done next to nothing with him & charged me €30 for their time. Got a cancellation 2 days later in our regular groomers & they groomed him beautifully in 1hr 15mins. They said most dogs will show resistance but you have to persevere & they will give in & let you groom but WTP groomer appears to have had very poor handling skills & let our young dog call the shots! Very disappointing, would not recommend.

The below response from groomer contains a lie: I did watch the video: it showed the groomer was holding phone with one hand and trying to groom the dog with the one free hand. The dog was dodging the clipper... it was a ridiculous clip and I asked her if she usually expects a dog to stand perfectly still & she said yes, obviously! Neat trick if you can groom any dog with one hand! A waste of our time and money.

The staff in this groomers are excellent, very competent and pleasant.
I have been going here for the past year and would highly recommend this groomers to everyone.

The staff were friendly but the quality of the grooming service was only fair.
Out of ten- only 5.
My dog’s grooming was not finished.
Fur around her neck and part of her chest was not cut.
Nails didn’t appear to be trimmed.
Overall not  satisfactory service.
If the groomer had told me that my dog was uncooperative I would have understood.
Cost was €80.
I could have groomed her better myself.
😳😳😳

Maria and Theo are amazing! I highly recommend What the pup! They care about their customers and their furry friends and they are very professional!
Do visit them and you will be amazed too! Thx Maria and Theo for looking after my dog! See you next time❤️
perfect space, perfect services, professional work. congratulations!!
Excellent service, pleasant staff, haven’t seen my dogs happier in a while😄 …

I recently visited What the Pup and couldn’t be happier! The staff were friendly, the space spotless, and my pet looked amazing after their session. They really tailored the grooming to my pet’s needs. Highly recommend for a stress-free and professional experience!

Great place. Would highly recommend as the owners are brilliant with dogs. I initially brought in my pet Lizard to be taken care of. After being informed that my lizard was not a dog, I left and brought back an actual dog to be taken care of. At least I know now that my lizard is not a dog. Also the owner is hot. So great place. Thanks guys. John R.
Great place! It was my pup’s first daycare experience and it went like a dream! Thank you Maria and Theo!

These guys are amazing, thank you for looking after Chester, he looks and smells fab.

Harry A.

What the pup is fantastic! Super professional, skilled, and efficient. Our dog is high maintenance with sensitive skin. She looked and smelled amazing after the grooming. The team took time to understand exactly what we wanted, and the customer service was outstanding—friendly and attentive from start to finish. Highly recommend!

What the Pup did an amazing job with my pet’s grooming!
The staff was friendly, professional, and clearly loves animals.
My pet looked fantastic, and the whole experience was stress-free.
Highly recommend for anyone looking for quality grooming and a team that really cares! 🤩🥰🔥🔥
You guys done a great job Grooming our Wilson
Sorry but 100€ for a 12kg dog groom? That’s just unaffordable
Did a wonderful job with my Jack Russell, he looks fab and they were so kind with him

I’m beyond impressed with What The Pup! They truly stand out for their personal touch and attention to detail. The staff ensures each dog feels comfortable, and the customized grooming services make it a premium experience. My fur baby …
The customer service is fantastic
My odin came out looking like a superstar. The guys are amazing groomers, such talent and care thank you.

We were delighted with Juno's groom and the care and attention that he got. Maria the owner is a true dog lover and her heart and soul is in this. So lovely to see and our dog seemed to enjoy the experience too! (this review was not requested but I felt compelled to write and support this new business)
